Subject: Vendor intake: PixelWave Labs — documentation & PO contact

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking our call yesterday. Per our onboarding checklist, I attached our W-9 and a bank letter. Can you confirm the exact vendor profile fields you need to create PixelWave in your systems so we can get POs flowing? Specifically: legal entity name, tax ID format you require, remit address, and the preferred PO/email address for purchase orders.

A few context items: we operate as PixelWave Labs, Inc. (MA) for contracts but invoices can be issued from the parent entity PixelWave Holdings LLC if that helps for tax routing. We prefer ACH payments; bank letter includes routing/account but we can also accept wire if needed.

Attachments: PixelWave_W9.pdf (W-9), PixelWave_bank_letter.pdf (bank confirmation)

Happy to fill any intake form you prefer — I can loop finance if you send it over.

Best,

Head of Finance
PixelWave Labs

Ian — thanks for the quick follow-up and attachments. Quick clarifying items so we can avoid back-and-forth when AP creates the master record: 

- Please confirm the single "legal name" we should store (we can add doing-business-as entries). In your note you mentioned PixelWave Labs, Inc. (MA) vs PixelWave Holdings LLC — which should appear on invoices to Redwood?
- Confirm the tax ID (TIN or EIN) exactly as it appears on the W-9.
- Preferred remit method: ACH (preferred) or Wire? For ACH we need the bank account holder name to match the legal vendor name on file.
- PO routing: do you want POs sent to procurement@pixelwave.com or to a person? If a person, include name/email and an AP invoice mailbox for attachments.

I attached our Redwood Onboarding Form (short) — could you complete sections 1–3 (legal name, remit address, AP contact, tax ID) and return it? I copied Kim (AP) so she can pick this up once you return the completed form.

Thanks — ping me if you want to jump on a 10-min call to finish.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher

Redwood Inference

2) EIN: 12-3456789 (matches W-9 attachment).
3) Remit method: ACH preferred; bank letter matches PixelWave Labs, Inc. Bank account holder is PixelWave Labs, Inc.
4) PO routing: please send POs to procurement@pixelwave.com (this mailbox is monitored by our ops team). Invoices should be routed to ap@pixelwave.com (cc for any exceptions to finance@pixelwave.com).

I filled out sections 1–3 on your attached onboarding form and attached the completed sheet. Let me know if the account name mismatch between the holdings LLC and the labs entity is a problem — we can have PixelWave Holdings LLC issue a one-off invoice if necessary, but standard ops will use PixelWave Labs, Inc.
